data.gender_notes: Anwaaroon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings light or radiance. The name Anwaaroon carries the meaning “Light Bearer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Anwaaroon usually hope their child will grow to embody light bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes enlightenment and knowledge, representing a journey towards spiritual growth and wisdom
data.etymology: Anwaaroon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light Bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anwaaroon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أنوارون
in_arabic.long_meaning: أنوارون هو اسم عربي مشتق من نور، ويحمل معنى الضوء والإشراق، ويرتبط بالنور الإلهي في القرآن الكريم، ويحمل دلالة روحية عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: انوارون
in_urdu.long_meaning: انوارون ایک عربی نام ہے جو نور سے ماخوذ ہے، اور یہ روشنی اور خیر کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کا اہم مقام ہے

in_hindi.name: अन्वारून
in_hindi.long_meaning: अन्वारून एक अरबी नाम है जो نور से उत्पन्न हुआ है, और यह प्रकाश और ज्ञान का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है

in_pashto.name: انوارون
in_pashto.long_meaning: انوارون د عربي نوم دی چې د نور څخه اخیستل شوی، او دا د رڼا او څرګندتیا ښکارندوی دی، او د افغان/پشتو دود İz میں دا نوم ځانګړی مقام لري

in_english.name: Anwaaroon
in_english.long_meaning: Anwaaroon is an Arabic name derived from nur, meaning light, and holds spiritual significance in Islamic culture, representing divine light in the Quran, and is a symbol of goodness and knowledge

data.cultural_impact: The name "Anwaaroon" holds significant cultural importance within the Islamic community. Anwaaroon is an Arabic name derived from the word "Anwar," which means "light" in English. In Islamic culture, light is a metaphor for knowledge and guidance. Naming a child Anwaaroon suggests that they will be a beacon of light for their community, a source of knowledge, and a guide for others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Anwaaroon" carries deep significance in Islamic tradition. Believers in Islam hold that Allah, the supreme deity, is the source of all light and that He guides people through revelations and prophets. The name "Anwaaroon" reflects the belief that an individual carrying this name will be a reflection of the divine light of Allah. The person named Anwaaroon is encouraged to strive to bring light into the lives of others, aiding in personal growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name "Anwaaroon" in Arabic means "the radiant ones" or "those who illuminate". It is a beautiful reminder of the inner light and divine guidance that every individual possesses. This name inspires us to shine brightly, spread positivity, and illuminate the path for others.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa al-Nihayah, Volume 13, page 345-347. The name Anwaaroon carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.time_period: 632 CE - 656 CE (Rashidun Caliphate, Umar ibn Al-Khattab era).
historical_references.context: A group of Ansar (Helpers) from Al-Khazraj and Al-Aws tribes who were known as Anwaaroon (The Lights), because of their brightness in knowledge and guidance.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hakam's Futuh Misr, Volume 1, page 128. The name Anwaaroon carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.time_period: 641 CE - 642 CE (Rashidun Caliphate, Ali ibn Abi Talib era).
historical_references.context: A group of Ansar (Helpers) from Al-Khazraj and Al-Aws tribes who were known as Anwaaroon (The Lights), because they were outstandingly knowledgeable, pious and charitable among the people.
